neighbours.label: a comma or 'But' opening a conversational aside after sentence-initial But / Because
fire: I loved the first book. But, honestly, the sequel was a mess.
We should pick one, right? But wait, why are there two versions?
I'm buying the red coat because, truth be told, it was on sale.
The plot is silly. But seriously, the acting is wonderful.
I can't decide which pills to take. Because, let's face it, the labels are tiny.
She says she hates sci-fi. But, BUT, look at her bookshelf!
I'll go to the party. But, to be fair, I'll leave early.
It doesn't really matter. But still, I'd like to know the answer.
quiet: I loved the first book, and the sequel was quite good as well.
We should pick one of the two versions on the list today.
I'm buying the red coat since it was on sale last weekend.
The plot is silly, and the acting is wonderful in every scene.
I can't decide which pills to take, and the labels are tiny.
She says she hates sci-fi, and her bookshelf is full of poetry.
I'll go to the party and leave early to catch the last bus.
It doesn't really matter, so I'll just pick the first answer.
